articles.title: Dwarf Fortress is getting the mother of all magic updates
articles.zh: 矮人要塞迎来史上最大魔法更新，波及宇宙根本法则
articles.summary: 如果你在玩矮人要塞或关注独立游戏，这次更新连世界底层宇宙观都会改，值得重新开档
articles.body:
Infamously simulation-heavy colony builder Dwarf Fortress is getting a Myth and Magic update that, at the possible risk of being maybe a touch hyperbolic, threatens to make all other fantasy game spellcraft look like a sleepy bout of Got Your Nose. It's summarised by Bay12 co-founder Tarn Adams as a set of procedural systems "that go beyond combining spell effects... straight to the fundamental cosmological makeup of the universe", allowing for "magical situations that you cannot get any other way."

So many dwarves are going to die, aren't they, Tarn? And in such exotic and unexpected ways. Here's a brief video announcing the update, which is coming later this year.

If I'm reading the tea leaves correctly, the update will generate a variety of approaches to sorcery in the course of regular world generation. Distinct species of wizardry and witchcraft will arise with tectonic abandon in the course of laying down rivers and mountains, and charting the fates of creatures, populations and settlements. It certainly sounds like a big bounce beyond the existing relatively threadbare magic system . As Adams goes on, this will allow "your fortresses to pursue magical research that really feels like discovery", encompassing "magic materials, enchantments, rituals, and ruins" together with spells that just "blow things up". You can see a few examples in the video, including a goblin-shredding hex that doubles as a means of shifting stone. All of it tied into "how that particular universe works down to its bones", Adams promises.

They've been working on the feature for many years. I probably don't need to remind you Rock Paper Magma Shotgunners that Dwarf Fortress is pretty intense and elaborate even without any procgen thaumaturgy. If you do need reminding, here's Nate's old Basement of Curiosity series . Please bear in mind that the first entry was written in 2019, long before the launch of the Steam edition with its more approachable artstyle – the game has grown horrifyingly since then. In 2023, Sin also had thoughts on why none of Dwarf Fortress's many imitators or fellow travellers have managed to eclipse it.
articles.bodyZh:
以模拟系统复杂著称的《矮人要塞》（Dwarf Fortress）即将迎来一个“神话与魔法”更新。说得夸张一点，这更新一出，其他奇幻游戏里的施法系统可能全都要变成小打小闹的“躲猫猫”了。Bay12联合创始人塔恩·亚当斯（Tarn Adams）概括说，这是一套程序生成系统，“不止是组合法术效果……而是直接深入到宇宙的基本构成层面”，能催生出“你在别的地方完全体验不到的魔法情境”。

所以，塔恩，很多矮人怕是要死了吧？而且死法还千奇百怪、出乎意料？这里有一段简短的视频，介绍了这个更新，预计今年晚些时候上线。

如果我没看错风向的话，这次更新会在常规的世界生成过程中，孕育出各种各样的魔法流派。在生成河流山川、谱写生物、种群和聚落命运的同时，各种巫术和魔法的独特物种也会随之野蛮生长。听上去确实比现有那套相对单薄的魔法系统是一个巨大的飞跃。亚当斯继续说，这将让“你的要塞能够进行真正有探索感的魔法研究”，涵盖“魔法材料、附魔、仪式和遗迹”，还有那些纯粹“把东西炸上天”的法术。你可以在视频里看到几个例子，包括一个能把哥布林撕碎的诅咒，顺便还能用来移石开路。亚当斯承诺，所有这些都跟“那个特定宇宙最底层的运作方式”紧密相连。

这个功能他们已经捣鼓了很多年了。我大概不用提醒各位《岩石纸浆岩浆霰弹枪》（Rock Paper Magma Shotgun）的读者，《矮人要塞》就算没有任何程序生成的魔法，本身也已经够硬核够复杂了。如果你确实需要提醒，可以看看奈特（Nate）以前写的“好奇心地下室”（Basement of Curiosity）系列。不过请注意，第一篇是2019年写的，那还是Steam版带着更友好的美术风格上线很久之前的事——从那以后，这游戏的复杂度又可怕地膨胀了。2023年，Sin也写过一篇文章，探讨为什么《矮人要塞》的众多模仿者和同路人没有一个能超越它。

categories.commentary: 今天这批论文关键词是"可控"——从可解释、可编排到可遗忘、可量化，全是冲着实操落地去的。

articles.title: MURANO: Design, Run, and Reproduce Mechanistic Interpretability Experiments as Composable Pipelines
articles.zh: MURANO：将机制可解释性实验的设计、运行与复现封装为可组合流水线
articles.summary: 如果你在搞模型可解释性研究却总被复现坑，这个框架把实验流程标准化，能省掉大量重复劳动。
articles.author: Alireza Bayat Makou, Emirhan Böge 等
articles.body: This paper presents Murano, an open source framework for designing, running, and reproducing mechanistic interpretability studies of large language models, intended for researchers across disciplines. These studies often combine loading, recording, attribution, intervention, and evaluation, while existing libraries tend to focus on different parts of this workflow. As a result, researchers using several libraries may need to adapt outputs from one for use by another. To bridge this gap, Murano represents operations from these five areas as composable steps. Steps exchange named result artifacts and declare the inputs they require and the outputs they produce. A pipeline executes its steps in the order supplied, and Murano uses canonical addresses when component identities pass between operations. Murano builds on existing interpretability and machine learning libraries. We demonstrate Murano through two reproductions of established interpretability studies and one illustrative sparse autoencoder case study.
articles.bodyZh:
这篇论文介绍的是 Murano，一个开源框架，主要用来设计、运行和复现大语言模型的机制可解释性研究（mechanistic interpretability），面向的是各个学科的研究人员。这类研究通常得把加载模型、记录信息、归因分析、干预、评估这几个环节串起来，但现有的各种库往往只专注其中某一块。结果就是，研究人员如果有好几个库要配合使用，经常得把一个库的输出调整成另一个库能用的格式。

为了解决这个问题，Murano 把上面这五个环节的操作都做成了可以自由组合的步骤。这些步骤之间靠"命名结果产物"来传递数据，每个步骤会声明自己需要什么输入、能产出什么输出。一条流水线（pipeline）按传入顺序执行各个步骤，当组件身份在操作之间传递时，Murano 会用规范化地址来标识。Murano 是在已有的可解释性库和机器学习库的基础上搭建的。我们通过复现两篇成熟的可解释性研究，再加上一个稀疏自编码器（sparse autoencoder）的示例案例，来展示 Murano 的实际用法。

articles.title: SwarmBench: Can Large Language Models Act as Agent Swarm Orchestrators?
articles.zh: SwarmBench：大语言模型能当好智能体集群的编排者吗？
articles.summary: 如果你在用多Agent架构做产品，这个基准能帮你判断LLM适不适合当那个"总指挥"。
articles.author: Jinshan Gao, Zhuoran Jin 等
articles.body: Large language model-based multi-agent systems are evolving from fixed interaction topologies toward dynamically orchestrated Agent Swarms. However, existing benchmarks are still largely based on single-agent or general-purpose agent tasks, making it difficult to systematically evaluate key orchestration capabilities. We propose SwarmBench, a benchmark that evaluates model performance from multiple perspectives, including accuracy, efficiency, cost, and process quality. Experimental results show that current models exhibit substantial differences in orchestration capability. These differences are reflected not only in final accuracy, efficiency, and cost, but also in the overall quality of the orchestration process itself. Based on these findings, we further propose SwarmExp, a simple yet effective method based on experience extraction and experience replay, which consistently improves the orchestration performance of large language models.
articles.bodyZh:
基于大语言模型（large language model）的多智能体（multi-agent）系统，正在从固定的交互结构，逐步进化成动态编排的“智能体蜂群”（Agent Swarms）。但目前已有的评测基准，大多还停留在单个智能体或者通用型任务上，很难系统性地检验这种关键的编排能力。

为此，我们提出了SwarmBench——一个从准确性、效率、成本和过程质量等多个维度，全面评估模型表现的基准测试。实验结果显示，现有模型在编排能力上差异相当明显。这些差异不仅体现在最终的准确性、效率和成本上，也体现在整个编排过程本身的质量上。

基于这些发现，我们进一步提出了SwarmExp。这是一种简单却很有效的方法，核心思路是经验提取（experience extraction）加经验回放（experience replay），能够稳定地提升大语言模型的编排表现。

articles.title: Fine-Grained Multi Image Object Hallucination Benchmark
articles.zh: 细粒度多图像物体幻觉基准测试
articles.summary: 如果你在测多模态模型，多图场景下的"看图编造"问题比单图更隐蔽，这篇给出了专门的测评标准。
articles.author: Joonki Min, Chaeyun Kim 等
articles.body: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-image scenarios requiring complex reasoning across visual contexts. However, current MLLMs remain fundamentally limited by object hallucination-generating plausible yet factually inconsistent descriptions about objects. Existing benchmarks, designed primarily for single-image settings or providing only high-level multi-image assessments, cannot systematically diagnose how visual complexity and reasoning demands trigger hallucination. To address this gap, we introduce MIOH, a fine-grained multi-image object hallucination benchmark that systematically evaluates object hallucination across four foundational tasks (existence, counting, attribute, position) through three multi-image reasoning patterns (comprehensive, comparative, selective) under three controlled adversarial pressures (visual context scale, perceptual difficulty, contextual bias). Through evaluation of 29 models, we reveal that even state-of-the-art systems like GPT-5 and Gemini-2.5-Pro exhibit distinct failure patterns across different reasoning patterns and tasks. Our evaluation reveals that hallucination stems not merely from perceptual failures but from integration-stage limitations when maintaining object representations across multiple images. MIOH provides a controlled framework for analyzing multi-image object hallucination and serves as a critical evaluation tool for developing more reliable multimodal AI systems.
articles.bodyZh:
多模态大模型（MLLMs）现在越来越多地用在需要跨图像复杂推理的场景里。可问题是，这类模型一直有个硬伤——物体幻觉（object hallucination），就是说它们会编出一些听起来像那么回事、实际上跟事实对不上的物体描述。

现在的测评基准呢，要么就是为单张图设计的，要么对多张图也只是给个粗泛的评估，根本没法系统搞清楚，视觉复杂度跟推理需求是怎么诱发幻觉的。

为了补上这个缺口，我们搞了个新基准，叫MIOH。它专门针对多图像物体幻觉，设计得很细致。具体来说，它在三个受控的对抗压力（视觉上下文规模、感知难度、上下文偏差）下，用三种多图像推理模式（综合、比较、选择），系统性地测四个基础任务（存在性、计数、属性、位置）。

我们拿29个模型跑了一遍，结果发现，哪怕是顶尖的系统，比如GPT-5和Gemini-2.5-Pro，在不同推理模式和任务上，也会各自露馅，翻车的路子还都不一样。

更重要的是，测试暴露了一个真相：幻觉的产生，不光是因为模型看错了（感知问题），更关键的是，它在把多张图的信息整合到一起、保持物体表征的时候，整合阶段出了毛病。

MIOH这个框架，给了我们一个受控环境来分析多图像物体幻觉，同时也是一把利器，帮我们开发更靠谱的多模态AI系统。

articles.title: PyKEEN-NSX: A Modular Framework for Static, Dynamic and Schema-Aware Negative Sampling in PyKEEN
articles.zh: PyKEEN-NSX：面向静态、动态与模式感知负采样的PyKEEN模块化框架
articles.summary: 如果你用PyKEEN训练知识图谱嵌入，这个扩展把负采样策略统一了，不用再自己拼实现。
articles.author: Ivan Diliso, Nicola Fanizzi 等
articles.body: Embedding methods have become popular due to their scalability on link prediction and/or triple classification tasks on Knowledge Graphs (KGs). Embedding models are trained relying on both positive and negative samples of triples. However, since KGs generally contain only positive assertions, negative samples are artificially generated through negative sampling strategies, ranging from simple random corruption to more sophisticated approaches that exploit structural, semantic, or embedding information. The design and implementation of advanced negative samplers remains challenging, as most popular Knowledge Graph Embedding (KGE) libraries provide support only for basic strategies and lack a unified framework for developing more advanced and customized solutions. To address this gap, we introduce PyKEEN-NSX, an extension of PyKEEN, the popular KGE framework, that provides a modular engineered abstraction for negative sampling. The proposed architecture separates the generation of candidate negative pools, conditioned on an explicit context, from the selection strategy, enabling the development and integration of static, schema-aware and dynamic approaches within a consistent framework. Based on this abstraction, we implement six negative samplers, while remaining fully compatible with existing PyKEEN workflows and pipelines. As a proof of concept, we study negative availability across four datasets, showing that constrained pools frequently fall below the requested number of negatives, so that the encoded criterion is to a large extent replaced by the random fallback that supplements them.
articles.bodyZh:
嵌入方法因为能在知识图谱（Knowledge Graphs，简称KGs）上做链接预测和三元组分类，而且扩展性好，所以越来越流行。嵌入模型训练的时候，既要靠正样本，也要靠负样本。但问题来了，知识图谱里一般只存正面的断言，负样本得靠人工生成，也就是用各种负采样策略造出来。这些策略从简单的随机破坏，到更高级的利用结构、语义或者嵌入信息的办法都有。不过，设计并实现高级的负采样器仍然是个难题，因为市面上主流的知识图谱嵌入（Knowledge Graph Embedding，简称KGE）库基本只支持基础策略，也缺少一个统一的框架去开发更高级、更定制化的方案。

为了解决这个问题，我们推出了PyKEEN-NSX。它是PyKEEN这个流行KGE框架的一个扩展，为负采样提供了一套模块化的工程抽象。我们提出的架构把“候选负样本池的生成”和“选择策略”分开了，前者会依赖一个明确的上下文，这样就能在同一个框架里开发和集成静态的、基于模式（schema-aware）的还有动态的方法。基于这套抽象，我们实现了六个负采样器，而且跟PyKEEN现有的工作流和管道完全兼容。为了做个概念验证，我们研究了四个数据集上负样本的可用性，结果发现加了限制的候选池经常凑不够要求的负样本数量，也就是说，你设定的筛选条件在很大程度上被随机回退补齐给替代了。

articles.title: Geometry of Divergence: Tracking Hidden-State Trajectories for Adaptive Multi-Turn Reasoning
articles.zh: 发散几何：通过追踪隐状态轨迹实现自适应多轮推理
articles.summary: 如果你头疼LLM多轮对话"越聊越偏"，这篇用隐状态轨迹的几何特征来预判并干预推理跑偏。
articles.author: Jie Liang, Zhengxin Yu 等
articles.body: LLM agents need to sustain goal-consistent reasoning across long multi-turn interactions under strict resource constraints. However, as the multi-turn context accumulates, it can destabilize the underlying LLM's internal representation of task-relevant information from earlier turns, blurring the boundary between constructive reasoning and representation drift. We formulate multi-turn reasoning as a hidden-state trajectory of the underlying LLM that is characterized via two complementary signals: temporal curvature that captures the directional consistency of turn-to-turn updates, and variance slope which measures the expansion or contraction of the exploration space. Across four tasks and three underlying LLMs, we observed that these geometric signals distinguish between correct and incorrect episodes prior to completion. We further decompose each episode into three-action chains formed from four actions (Read, Write, Respond, Transfer) and show that separability is action-dependent, with different signals distinguishing various chain patterns. Our experiments demonstrate that trajectory geometry can identify critical turns in the reasoning process, increasing task success rates on $τ$-Bench from 24.1% to 39.6% while reducing token cost by 11.2%.
articles.bodyZh: LLM智能体（LLM agent）需要在严格的资源限制下，于多轮长交互中持续保持与目标一致的推理。但问题在于，随着多轮上下文的不断累积，底层大模型对早期任务相关信息的内在表征会逐渐被扰动，导致"有建设性的推理"和"表征漂移"之间的界限越来越模糊。我们把多轮推理看作底层大模型的一条隐状态轨迹（hidden-state trajectory），并用两套互补的信号来描述它：一是时间曲率（temporal curvature），衡量逐轮更新在方向上的连贯性；二是方差斜率（variance slope），衡量探索空间是在扩张还是在收缩。在四个任务、三款底层大模型的实验里，我们发现这些几何信号能在推理完成之前就区分出正确与错误的回合。我们还把每个回合拆解成由四种动作（读取Read、写入Write、响应Respond、传递Transfer）构成的三动作链，结果表明这种可区分性与动作类型密切相关——不同的链模式要靠不同的信号来识别。实验进一步显示，轨迹几何能精准定位推理过程中的关键节点，把τ-Bench上的任务成功率从24.1%拉到39.6%，同时把token开销压低了11.2%。

articles.title: Where Identity Lives: Localized, Retain-Free Identity Unlearning in Multimodal Large Language Models
articles.zh: 身份信息藏在哪里：多模态大模型中的局部化免保留身份遗忘
articles.summary: 如果你在处理模型隐私删除请求，这篇展示了一种无需原始训练数据就能精准抹掉特定身份的办法。
articles.author: Kangwook Ko, Jaehyuk Jang 等
articles.body: Removing a specific individual's information from multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is often needed after deployment, but existing methods rely on a retain set, which is hardest to obtain at that point, and rebuilding it recreates the privacy exposure that unlearning aims to remove. Forgetting from the forget set alone instead damages the shared visual-language computation, harming perception. We cast retain-free unlearning as a localization problem: causal tracing, weight transplant, and Fisher overlap all point to early-to-mid decoder MLPs as the layers where identity information is stored and, unlike other module families, can be modified without substantially disrupting vision. We turn this into Pathway-Aware Visual-attribute Anchoring (PAVA), which confines updates to these layers and pairs a forget loss with a visual-attribute anchor that preserves image-grounded behavior by distilling the model's own pre-unlearning answers from the forget images alone. On MLLMU-Bench and ReMem, PAVA gives the strongest forget-retain trade-off among forget-set-only methods and remains competitive with retain-based baselines.
articles.bodyZh: 在多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）部署之后，经常会需要把某个特定个人的信息从模型里抹掉。可现有的遗忘（unlearning）方法都得靠一个“保留集”（retain set）——这个玩意儿恰恰是在部署阶段最难搞到的，而且你要重新构建保留集，就等于是把当初想通过遗忘来消除的隐私暴露又给重演了一遍。要是只从“遗忘集”（forget set）下手去忘，那又会把视觉和语言共享的那套计算给弄坏，感知能力跟着遭殃。于是我们把这种不需要保留集的遗忘问题，转成了一个“定位”问题：用因果追踪（causal tracing）、权重移植（weight transplant）和费雪重叠（Fisher overlap）一查，发现身份信息主要存在解码器（decoder）里偏前中期的多层感知机（MLP）层里，而且这类层跟其他模块不一样，动它们不太会破坏视觉功能。基于这个发现，我们提出了一种方法，叫“通路感知的视觉属性锚定”（Pathway-Aware Visual-attribute Anchoring, PAVA）。它把更新范围就限定在刚才说的那些层里，同时把遗忘损失和一个“视觉属性锚”（visual-attribute anchor）配在一起——这个锚靠蒸馏模型自己、从遗忘图像里去提取还没被遗忘之前的回答，来保住模型基于图像的行为能力。在 MLLMU-Bench 和 ReMem 这两个评测集上，PAVA 在所有只用遗忘集的方法里，拿到了最强的“遗忘—保留”权衡，而且跟那些还需要保留集的方法比，也一点不落下风。

articles.title: What It Costs to Compose, Rebuild, and Correct Precomputed Memory
articles.zh: 组合、重建与修正预计算记忆的代价
articles.summary: 如果你在给Agent挂外部记忆模块，这篇把"改记忆"的计算成本算清了，方便你做架构取舍。
articles.author: Asa Shepard
articles.body: Language models can answer from precomputed memory, a model's saved reading of a body of material, reused across requests instead of read again at each. This paper maps where that practice preserves correctness and the conditions under which it fails. Across experiments on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct using both saved key-value caches and trained compressions of them, precomputed memory degrades when assembled from separately prepared parts, stays current only through rebuilds costing a large fraction of full preparation in our measurements, and ignores corrections served beside it conditional on phrasing. If precomputed memories can be served alongside one another, be cost-efficiently rebuilt, and be superseded by new information arriving in real-time, they can serve as a way to avoid re-feeding context to a model over repeated queries. The implication of our results for a deployed system that deals with a variety of queries is that precomputed memories are best rebuilt on the cadence at which new information changes what the memory was originally computed from. Both warm-rebuilding trained compressions of key-value caches and serving specifically-phrased updates beside a memory, as pasted text or injected cache state, show particular promise for keeping precomputed memories current, the latter as an interim measure between rebuilds, and we measure the cost and name the remaining questions associated with each.
articles.bodyZh:
语言模型可以用“预计算记忆”（precomputed memory）来回答问题——所谓预计算记忆，就是模型先把一批材料读一遍，把理解存下来，之后每次请求直接调用，不用再重读。这篇论文要摸清楚，这种做法在什么场合下能保持答案正确，什么情况下会翻车。

我们在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上跑了一堆实验，用的都是保存的键值缓存（key-value cache）以及对这些缓存做训练压缩（trained compression）的结果。结果发现，预计算记忆要是拿几块各自准备的部分拼起来，性能就会打折扣；它只能靠重建来保持最新，而我们实测下来，重建的成本差不多抵得上从头准备一次；另外，就算你在它旁边给补充更正信息，它也可能视而不见——这取决于你怎么措辞。假如预计算记忆能彼此并存、低成本重建、还能被实时到来的新信息覆盖，那它就能在反复查询时省得一遍遍地把上下文喂给模型。我们的结果对实际部署的系统有什么启发呢？如果你要处理各种查询，那最好按照新信息改变原有计算内容的节奏来重建预计算记忆。

无论是“热重建”（warm-rebuilding）键值缓存的训练压缩，还是在记忆旁边喂一些专门措辞的更新——以粘贴文本或者注入缓存状态的形式——对保持预计算记忆不过时都挺有前景；后者尤其适合作为两次重建之间的临时措施。我们把相关成本也测了，并且把每种方式还没解决的问题指了出来。

articles.title: BiG-SURE - Bipartite Graph for Semantic Uncertainty and Reliability Estimation of LLMs
articles.zh: BiG-SURE：基于二分图的LLM语义不确定性与可靠性估计
articles.summary: 如果你想把"模型这句话能不能信"变成量化指标，这个二分图方法比直接看置信度分数更稳。
articles.author: Debarpan Bhattacharya, Malay Phadke 等
articles.body: Reliable uncertainty estimation is a crucial requirement for deploying large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) in safety-critical settings, especially when the model parameters are not accessible (black-box). We propose BiG-SURE, an uncertainty estimator based on cross-temperature semantic agreement. The method samples low-temperature responses as stable semantic anchors and high-temperature responses as probes under meaning-preserving input transformations. It then constructs an anchor-probe Bipartite Graph (BiG) using NLI-based entailment scores and defines confidence through the normalized squared spectral energy of this matrix, with uncertainty given by its complement. This bipartite graph-based Semantic Uncertainty and Reliability Estimation (SURE) score measures whether high-temperature probes remain semantically aligned with the model's stable low-temperature belief or not. We evaluate BiG-SURE on text QA, multilingual QA, and multimodal QA tasks across multiple model families. In these experiments, BiG-SURE improves average abstention AUROC over prior black-box uncertainty estimators, while remaining simple, unsupervised, and applicable to black-box model settings.
articles.bodyZh: 要说可靠的不确定性估计，这在安全关键的场合里部署大型语言模型（LLMs）和视觉语言模型（VLMs）时可太重要了，特别是当模型的参数你拿不到，也就是黑盒（black-box）模型的时候。我们提出了一个叫BiG-SURE的方法，它是一种基于跨温度语义一致性的不确定性估计器。具体做法是，在不让输入意思改变的前提下，先采样一些低温响应作为稳定的语义锚点，再拿高温响应当探针来用。然后，它用基于NLI（自然语言推断）的蕴涵分数去构建一个锚点-探针二分图（BiG），并借着这个矩阵的归一化平方谱能量来定义置信度，不确定度就是置信度反过来那个补数。这个基于二分图的语义不确定性和可靠性估计（SURE）分数，主要就是看看那些高温探针是不是还跟模型那个稳定的低温信念在语义上保持一致。我们在文本问答、多语言问答还有多模态问答任务上，对好几个不同的模型系列都测了BiG-SURE。实验下来，BiG-SURE比之前那些黑盒不确定性估计器的平均弃权AUROC（ROC曲线下面积）更高，而且它又简单、又不需要监督，还能直接用在黑盒模型场景里。
